name: Create
steps: If no idea is selected run Mode 4 and stop for the user's choice of exactly three finalists
tasks create TASK_ID --domain DOMAIN (registers PENDING_AUTHORING work order + stub bundle)
Write requirement-to-evidence contract matrix first
Inventory data; keep only files needed for a graded case; licence and <=1 GB
Write instruction.md as WHAT not HOW with absolute /app outputs
Write task.toml, agent-neutral Dockerfile, independent solve.sh/solve.py with hand-computed fixtures
Write >=10 deterministic weighted tests incl. hidden/reseeded inputs, program reruns, anti-cheat negatives
Write >=8 rubric criteria, five stated constraints first, no state_change, no overlap
Write task-only README; generate TRUTH last from disk
Follow verify.md on the exact final hash
outputs: handoff report: path, counts, coverage, assets, QC, oracle/nop/stub, NOT_EVALUATED, blockers

name: Harden
steps: Hash and preserve baseline; inspect unrelated edits
Run/import scoped QC and scores; missing = NOT_RUN/NOT_EVALUATED
Diagnosis table separating validity defect, weak difficulty, unsupported complaint/infrastructure
Close unintended disclosure; preserve good rubrics and mechanisms; fix derivations not expected answers
Strengthen via adversarial fixtures, rule interaction, completeness, boundary ownership, reconciliation, precision, reruns
Replace easy rubric criteria with distinct conduct evidence
Rebuild contract matrix and all-pairs observable map
tasks harden TASK_ID (new PENDING_AUTHORING revision)
Regenerate TRUTH last; verify baseline and revision

name: Overgenerate/refine
steps: tasks overgenerate TASK_ID
Create 6-10 mechanism sketches; reject reskins, hidden-info tricks, unsupported performance gates
Compare on transitions, breadth, interaction depth, gradeability, assets, shortcuts, solvability
Present exactly three finalists (prompts/idea-workshop.md C); user chooses
Build the selected finalist via create.md
Ask for runtime policy; ingest every attempt; never rerun until favorable
Diagnose failed observables; check every run test<90 rubric<90 combined<30
Refine minimally; recompute coverage, overlap, weights, TRUTH
Pause after three total rounds

name: ChatGPT Ideas
steps: ideas start TASK_ID DOMAIN
Emit prompt A; user pastes into ChatGPT; preserve raw reply
Critique each candidate on 8 axes
Issue targeted refinement requests (prompt B)
Convert chosen three to candidate envelope; ideas submit
Show finalists (prompt C); user runs ideas select
Convert independent review to typed envelope; ideas submit (consumes a round)
Record rejected ideas and nearest matches

name: Upstream
inputs: update request or supplied source folder
steps: sources import FOLDER (NOT_ACTIVE snapshot) or sources check
Inventory without executing; record identity and hashes
Compare generator guidance, Input QC, Output QC separately; byte facts vs interpretation
Classify non-cap conflicts as defect, false positive, intentional incompatibility or unresolved
Proposal with paths, base hashes, diff, migration, rollback, QC and difficulty effect
sources baseline propose -> proposals approve -> sources baseline apply; generator files via updates propose/apply

name: Verify
steps: tasks verify TASK_ID (hash)
qc verify BUNDLE --kind input (pinned checkers)
qc semantic-schema / semantic-submit (fresh semantic review)
Two-direction coverage and observable matrix
Oracle/fixture/verifier isolation review
If authorized: 2 oracle=1.000, 1 nop=0.000, 1 stub with paying tests; runs import
If policy configured: every model run test<90 rubric<90 combined<30
qc waive for reviewed WARN/MINOR only
qc status; rehash; release check

name: Resume
inputs: explicit task, run or transaction id
steps: status
resume TASK_ID
recovery TX {resume,rollback} or updates recover {resume,rollback} if required
Reload mode, scope, settings hash, counters, evidence, pending decisions
Rehash; mark stale receipts and approvals
Continue at first incomplete gate

name: Settings
inputs: view request, or exact key/value changes with reason, impact, rollback
steps: settings view
settings propose --changes FILE | --max-tests N
proposals approve PROPOSAL_ID (separate operator interaction)
settings apply PROPOSAL_ID APPROVAL_ID

name: Benchmark
steps: references inventory SOURCE LABEL
benchmarks analyze INVENTORY_ID METADATA
Hash/inventory bundles, scores, trajectories; mark unknowns
Record PL designation as metadata only
Normalize only comparable runs; dedupe
Compare mechanisms and assertion targets
benchmarks submit ANALYSIS_ID REVIEW; benchmarks status

name: Feedback
steps: feedback analyze INPUT_JSON
Ask smallest missing-data question
Test reachability, contract uniqueness, contradictions, ABI, boundaries, environment, oracle, verifier
Classify into five categories
Quantify recurrence with numerator/denominator
feedback submit ANALYSIS_ID REVIEW; feedback status

name: Reference Library
steps: references inventory SOURCE LABEL
references analyze INVENTORY_ID
Start from source-catalog.md and catalog.json
Group by experiment; dedupe
Label claims: measurement, pinned rule, hypothesis, contradiction, question
references submit / status

name: QC Repair
inputs: exactly one report (file, folder or text)
optional trajectory, output evidence, QC snapshot
steps: qc-repair open (no QC run, no revision)
bind-snapshot / confirm-subject if NEEDS_INPUT
analysis-schema; analysis-submit (Real/False positive/Vague, full section coverage)
table (Q ids)
select --instruction|--selection-file
selection-submit (dependencies, allowed/must-update paths, risk choices)
apply --selection-id (new revision + work order)
agent edits only authorized paths
verify (diff, bijection, counts, pinned-snapshot QC)
attach-evidence for output QC
verification-submit; report; continue if paused
